test_list_jobs: test the TestListJobs class to verify GET /api/jobs returns a job list with status 200
test_create_job_validation: test the TestCreateJob class to verify input validation rejects missing name, long names, and invalid repeat values
test_get_job_not_found: test the TestGetJob class to verify GET /api/jobs/{id} returns 404 when job does not exist
test_update_job_field_sanitization: test the TestUpdateJob class to verify PATCH /api/jobs/{id} rejects unknown fields like __proto__ and evil_field
test_auth_required: test the TestAuthRequired class to verify 401 responses when API_SERVER_KEY is set and no Authorization header is provided
